it: \bPorta un Eevee qui, prima o poi.

id: \bSomething amazing will happen if you do.
en: \bSomething amazing will happen if you do.
it: \bSe lo fai, succederà qualcosa di straordinario.
\rHai visto del Miele da queste parti?

id: \rWhat a strong Trainer. You deserve this.
en: \rWhat a strong Trainer. You deserve this.

id: \rDon't worry about me. Mothim will point me in the right direction.
en: \rDon't worry about me. Mothim will point me in the right direction.
it: \rNon preoccuparti per me. Mothim mi indicherà la direzione giusta.

id: \rI was sure I was going to win.
en: \rI was sure I was going to win.

id: \bWell well. What do we have here?
en: \bWell well. What do we have here?

id: \rGardenia: Hi there. Do you have any Grass types? A Gloom just escaped from me and I would love to see one.
en: \rGardenia: Hi there. Do you have any Grass types?  A Gloom just escaped from me and I would love to see one.
it: \rGardenia: Ciao! Hai Pokémon di tipo Erba?  Mi è appena scappato un Gloom e mi piacerebbe tanto vederne uno.

id: \rGardenia: That was a good battle. You should try the Eterna Gym out. I'm sure it will be worth it to you. See you soon I hope.
en: \rGardenia: That was a good battle. You should try the Eterna Gym out. I'm sure it will be worth it to you.  See you soon I hope.
it: \rGardenia: Bella lotta. Dovresti provare la Palestra di Evopoli. Sono sicura che ne varrà la pena.  A presto, spero.

id: \rNot a single thing about me that is unique.
en: \rNot a single thing about me that is unique.
it: \rNon c'è niente di unico in me.

id: \rJessie: Listen, is that a voice I hear?
en: \rJessie: Listen, is that a voice I hear?
it: \rJessie: Ascolta, è una voce quella che sento?

id: \bJames: It's speaking to me loud and clear.
en: \bJames: It's speaking to me loud and clear.
it: \bJames: Mi parla forte e chiaro, lo sento!

id: \rJessie: Bringing chaos at a breakneck pace.
en: \rJessie: Bringing chaos at a breakneck pace.
it: \rJessie: Portiamo il caos a velocità folle.

id: \bJames: Dashing hope, putting fear in its place.
en: \bJames: Dashing hope, putting fear in its place.
it: \bJames: Spezziamo la speranza e seminiamo il terrore.

id: \rJessie: A rose by any other name is just as sweet.
en: \rJessie: A rose by any other name is just as sweet.
it: \rJessie: Una rosa, con qualsiasi altro nome, avrebbe lo stesso profumo.

id: \bJames: When everything's worse, our work is complete.
en: \bJames: When everything's worse, our work is complete.
it: \bJames: Quando tutto va peggio, il nostro lavoro è compiuto.

id: \bMeowth: And Meowth, now that's a name!
en: \bMeowth: And Meowth, now that's a name!
it: \bMeowth: E Meowth, che nome da campione!

id: \rJessie: Putting the do-gooders in their place...
en: \rJessie: Putting the do-gooders in their place...
it: \rJessie: Rimettiamo al loro posto i buoni samaritani...
\rSono qui per superare la mia debolezza.
\bChi se ne importa. Non ho bisogno di vincere.
